Hero.MenuHint: Make adjustments to the Hero Point labels and iconography
Hero.SingularName: Singular Label for a Hero Point
Hero.SingularHint: Enter the *singular* name or label you want to use for a "Hero Point"
Hero.PluralHint: Enter the *plural* label to use in instances of many "Hero Points"
Hero.IconHint: Enter a FontAwesome icon name to use in place of the standard (H) symbol, such as "fa-circle-v" to represent Villain Points. Find one at https://fontawesome.com/search
Hero.UseAnHint: When replacing the hero point label, also replace "a" with "an", so that "a Hero Point" becomes "an Hero Point"
